snippet.title: THE WAR ON HOXXES BEGINS...
snippet.description:
I've been chipping away at this project for awhile, and I'm happy to say I can release it on the 25th of November! It's been really difficult with school and everything, so I've kept it hidden away for awhile!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Grab a friend, and shoot up Glyphids, Mactera, and a whole load of other bugs huge and small! Choose between the Driller, Engineer, Gunner, and Scout, and enter the cruel world of Hoxxes once more...

Inspired by the classic arcade game Mario Bros. See how long you can last wave after wave! Try to avoid being grabbed by Cave Leeches and Grabbers in the process...

Itch-io link:
https://neon-luigi.itch.io/drg-waronhoxxes

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Deep Rock Galactic and all characters in this game are sole property of Ghost Ship games, this is merely a fan project that will NOT be published with any goals of monetary gain.
